evidence.description: Checkbox labelled 'Starred only' is present and unticked by default.
Ticking the checkbox narrows the list to starred tasks only; covered at the domain level and the component level.
Status filter and 'Starred only' combine with logical AND; covered at the domain level and the component level.
Unstarring a visible task while 'Starred only' is ticked removes it from the list immediately.
Combined filters matching nothing show the existing role=status empty-state message, unchanged.
'Showing X of Y tasks' X reflects the combined-filter count while Y stays at the total.
